what: Pill and rectangle shapes (18% × 9% of the stage width, 28% × 14% on phone) fall onto the stage and pile up with matter-js physics. The first five drop at once, then one more every 3 seconds up to ten more (gravity 3, phone 1.4, density .2, friction 1.2, air .01, restitution .4, random angle from 200px above the stage). Each picker button, like the title letters, carries one of four colors × two shapes at random. Pressing one drops that color and shape and stops the automatic dropping. The buttons shrink to .9 over .4s, then expand over .4s while changing to a new color (expo.inOut, reshuffled if both are the same type). Hovering a button scales it to .95 (.2s), and a hand icon wanders between buttons over 2s, then goes to that button in 1.2s. Shapes can be grabbed and thrown with the mouse, and the clear button sweeps them all away.

options.zone: right (default — on wide screens it falls and piles up only on the right half of the stage, the left wall is center −40px) or full
options.size · size-m: Shape width ÷ stage width, default .18 · .28 — height is half of that, pill has half-height corners, square has 6px
options.first · max · every: Initial batch · number to drop automatically · auto interval (seconds), default 5 · 10 · 3
options.start · delay: load (default, after delay seconds) or event (fx:play), default delay .2
options.narrow: Width used for phone values, default 1024
options.stiffness: Drag stiffness when grabbed with the mouse, default .5
options.[data-fx-part=stage]: Panel where the shape is drawn (the element itself if none) — a box with position
options.[data-fx-part=pick]: Picker buttons — the part sets data-tone (1~4) and data-shape (round|rect). Colors are --fx-shape-1~4
options.[data-fx-part=cursor] · [data-fx-part=cl: Hand icon (--x 0~1 moved by --fx-cursor-step) · clear button · box where shapes catch and pile up (on phones it sits over the title line)
options.--fx-shape-1 ~ 4: Four colors (css variables), default is the accent color plus its hue-rotated green, orange and brown

from.where: about.html .ld-about (original #canvas-about matter.js 0.20 — stage 100vw, right half is a wall, the two-character title ‹Pick·Choose› works as the picking buttons)

note: matter-js 0.20’s mouse blocked wheel·touch on the stage so the page couldn’t scroll over it, so that was removed — wheel always, touch only on devices without a mouse (on phones shapes can’t be dragged)
